steps.name: Silas
steps.text: I have something. You will not want to know where I got it.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: I don't. Put it on the table. Not that table. The one that's mine.

steps.name: Silas
steps.text: It's a Mythic tile. It has... opinions.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: They all do, Silas. It's a hex of crystal and a bad attitude.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: That's the best warranty you've ever offered. Take it to the kid. Not for free.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: If it explodes, it's not my case. It's his case. I run a clean shop.
